title: Retry and rate-limit behavior of the Python SDK request executor

prose.text: The Python SDK retries a few statuses itself, on a schedule it takes from the response headers. The Go behavior is in [[shared.sdk-go.retries]].

checks.do: Whether the failing status is 429, 503 or 504, the only ones the executor retries.
Whether the failing response carried a Retry-After or rate-limit reset header, since without one the executor returns an error instead of retrying.
Whether the client set rateLimit.maxRetries or maxRetrySeconds.

max-retries-default.statement: The executor reads `client.rateLimit.maxRetries` from the configuration with a default of 2, and rejects a negative value.

quotes: raise ValueError(f"Invalid max retries: {self._max_retries}. Must be 0 or greater.")

timeout-default.statement: The executor reads `client.requestTimeout` with a default of 240 seconds.
